comment: Kernel-loader patch for the dashboard (tools\patch_kernel_dash.py). Per DLL: the MD5 of the original it applies to, the MD5 of the tested result, and per edit the file offset, the SHA-1 of the bytes it replaces (never the bytes themselves) and our replacement bytes.

edits.what: allowed-media check: always take its 'accepted' branch (dash.xex allows system flash only; the game folder is a DVD)
bounding-path mismatch (0xC00000CC): continue where a matching path continues (dash.xex may only load from \Device\Flash\dash.xex)
device-bound digest check: return success instead of 0xC000007B for DVD media (it accepts only hard drive / memory unit / USB)
